mapper.insert: /* 관리자 (권한관리) 역할권한 저장 쿼리 (saveRole)*/ MERGE INTO OCUOC_ROLEM_M A USING ( SELECT #{roleId} as ROLE_ID ,#{roleNm} as ROLE_NM ,#{useYn} as USE_YN ,#{frstRegEmpno} as FRST_REG_EMPNO FROM DUAL )B ON (A.ROLE_ID = B.ROLE_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.USE_YN = B.USE_YN WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ROLE_ID , ROLE_NM , USE_YN , FRST_REG_EMPNO , FRST_REG_DTTM ) VALUES ( B.ROLE_ID , B.ROLE_NM , B.USE_YN , B.FRST_REG_EMPNO , TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') )
mapper.select: /* 관리자 (권한관리) 메뉴권한 조회 쿼리 (getUserMenuList)*/ select M.MENU_ID AS menuId , M.MENU_NM AS menuNm , M.UPRN_MENU_ID AS uprnMenuId , M.MENU_LEVEL AS menuLevel , M.MENU_SER AS menuSer , COALESCE(U.USE_YN,'N') AS useYn FROM OCUOC_MENUN_M M LEFT JOIN OCUOC_USMUA_R U ON U.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID AND U.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} WHERE 1=1 AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY M.MENU_LEVEL, M.MENU_SER, M.MENU_ID

/* 관리자 (권한관리) 사용자권한 조회 쿼리 (selectUserAuth)*/ select R.ROLE_ID as roleId ,R.USER_ID as userId ,M.EMP_KOR_FLNM AS empKorFlnm ,M.HRA_PSTN_NM AS hraPstnNm ,B.BR_NM AS brNm ,R.USE_YN as useYn ,R.FRST_REG_EMPNO as frstRegEmpno from ocuoc_USROL_R R join OCUOC_USERI_M M on R.USER_ID = M.EMPNO JOIN OCUOC_DPRMI_M B ON M.BLNG_BRCD = B.BR_CD where 1=1
and ROLE_ID = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: /* 관리자 (권한관리) 사용자권한 저장 쿼리 (saveUser)*/ MERGE INTO OCUOC_USROL_R A USING ( SELECT #{roleId} as ROLE_ID ,#{userId} as USER_ID ,#{useYn} as USE_YN ,#{frstRegEmpno} as FRST_REG_EMPNO FROM DUAL )B ON ( A.ROLE_ID = B.ROLE_ID AND A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.USE_YN = B.USE_YN WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ROLE_ID , USER_ID , USE_YN , FRST_REG_EMPNO , FRST_REG_DTTM ) VALUES ( B.ROLE_ID , B.USER_ID , B.USE_YN , B.FRST_REG_EMPNO , TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') )
mapper.select: /* 관리자 (권한관리) 버튼권한 조회 쿼리 (selectUserBtnLsit)*/ SELECT B.BTN_CD AS btnCd , B.BTN_NM AS btnNm , CASE WHEN U.BTN_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS useYn , B.AREA_CD AS areaCd , B.ACTION_CD AS actionCd , B.IOCN_URL AS iocnUrl FROM ocuoc_buttn_m B LEFT JOIN ocuoc_USBTN_m U ON U.BTN_CD = B.BTN_CD AND U.MENU_ID = B.MENU_ID AND U.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} WHERE B.MENU_ID = #{menuId} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY B.BTN_CD
